title: How AI Is Reshaping Software Development Insights from  the 2025 DORA Report | AppDevANGLE
summary: DORA's Nathan Harvey summarizes the 2025 report: near-universal AI use, throughput up, persistent instability, and AI amplifying existing team strengths and weaknesses.

assertions.quote: with 90% of developers using AI daily
We're able to ship things more quickly and more frequently, but we still see those challenges with software delivery instability.
as you use more AI in your software delivery lifecycle, actually throughput and stability were both falling off.
One of those DORA AI capabilities is a clear and communicated stance on how you can use AI
We want AI to generate that code in smaller segments so that we have an opportunity to review that code
I'm going to spend much more time editing or reviewing code than I might have spent in the past writing code.
organizations that are trying to use AI as an alternative to hire the junior engineers is probably not the best approach
